Name: REINFORCE_PARAM_WEAPON_ST
Description: Determines the parameters for reinforcing weapons.

Fields.Name: Physical Damage (x)
Fields.Description: Physical damage at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded weapon. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Magic Damage (x)
Fields.Description: Magic damage at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded weapon. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Fire Damage (x)
Fields.Description: Fire damage at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded weapon. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Lightning Damage (x)
Fields.Description: Lightning damage at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded weapon. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Stamina Damage (x)
Fields.Description: How much stamina the weapon drains on a hit at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Poise Damage (x)
Fields.Description: Poise damage dealt at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded weapon. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Poise (x)
Fields.Description: Poise protection at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded weapon. 1 means unchanged.

Fields.Name: Correction: STR (x)
Fields.Description: How strongly Strength raises damage at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher means stronger scaling.

Fields.Name: Correction: DEX (x)
Fields.Description: How strongly Dexterity raises damage at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher means stronger scaling.

Fields.Name: Correction: INT (x)
Fields.Description: How strongly Intelligence raises damage at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher means stronger scaling.

Fields.Name: Correction: FTH (x)
Fields.Description: How strongly Faith raises damage at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher means stronger scaling.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Physical (x)
Fields.Description: How much physical damage the weapon blocks at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher blocks more.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Magic (x)
Fields.Description: How much magic damage the weapon blocks at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher blocks more.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Fire (x)
Fields.Description: How much fire damage the weapon blocks at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher blocks more.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Lightning (x)
Fields.Description: How much lightning damage the weapon blocks at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher blocks more.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Poison (x)
Fields.Description: How much poison buildup the weapon blocks at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher blocks more.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Toxic (x)
Fields.Description: How much toxic buildup the weapon blocks at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher blocks more.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Bleed (x)
Fields.Description: How much bleed buildup the weapon blocks at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher blocks more.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Curse (x)
Fields.Description: How much curse buildup the weapon blocks at this upgrade level. 1 means unchanged, higher blocks more.

Fields.Name: Guard Stability (x)
Fields.Description: Stability at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded weapon. 1 means unchanged, higher drains less stamina when blocking.

Fields.Name: Hit SpEffect Offset: 1
Fields.Description: Moves the weapon's first hit effect up its list at this upgrade level, usually to a stronger form. 0 keeps the base effect.

Fields.Name: Hit SpEffect Offset: 2
Fields.Description: Moves the weapon's second hit effect up its list at this upgrade level, usually to a stronger form. 0 keeps the base effect.

Fields.Name: Hit SpEffect Offset: 3
Fields.Description: Moves the weapon's third hit effect up its list at this upgrade level, usually to a stronger form. 0 keeps the base effect.

Fields.Name: Resident SpEffect Offset: 1
Fields.Description: Moves the weapon's first wielder effect up its list at this upgrade level, usually to a stronger form. 0 keeps the base effect.

Fields.Name: Resident SpEffect Offset: 2
Fields.Description: Moves the weapon's second wielder effect up its list at this upgrade level, usually to a stronger form. 0 keeps the base effect.

Fields.Name: Resident SpEffect Offset: 3
Fields.Description: Moves the weapon's third wielder effect up its list at this upgrade level, usually to a stronger form. 0 keeps the base effect.

Fields.Name: Material Set Offset
Fields.Description: Which upgrade stones this level needs, as a step up from the weapon's base list. 0 keeps the base list.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Level
Fields.Description: The upgrade level this row counts as, such as 10 for +10.
